figurative_meaning_en: preparing to fight; intimidating or threatening
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই পক্ষ আস্তিন গুটিয়ে একে অপরের উপর ঝাঁপিয়ে পড়ল।
রাজনৈতিক নেতারা আস্তিন গুটানোর ভঙ্গিতে বক্তৃতা দিচ্ছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The two sides rolled up their sleeves and lunged at each other.
The political leaders are rolling up their sleeves in a threatening manner during speeches.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of physical preparation for conflict, common in Bengali political and social rhetoric.
